name: floorplan-to-3d-house
description: Turn a house site plan or floor plan (PDF/DXF) into a DXF, a 2D plan for approval, an interactive 3D model (one or two storeys, style presets), elevations and a sun report, GLB/3D-DXF exports, the model opened in Blender and an optional Blender drone or walkthrough video.
